paragraphs.text: Sable is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of small carnivorous mammals. Sable is a species of marten valued for its fur.

The first (and only) creature to bear the type is Bronze Sable from Theros , which is actually an artifact creature . In The Theriad the bronze sables are described as the guardians of the shrine to Karametra .

Sable later also appeared as a type on The Wise Sable , a playtest card from the 2024 Amsterdam Unknown Event . It is an elder sable judge that references former Commander Advisory Group member and Level 3 judge Charlotte Sable .
